section: 第十一章　电流的磁场
title: The Magnetic Field of an Electric Current

prose.text:
An electric current not only experiences the action of a magnetic field;
it also produces a magnetic field.

A small current-carrying loop with known properties, used with an appropriate measurement method, can help us study the magnetic flux density vector $\vec{B}$ at different points.
For a current-carrying conductor, we consider both the magnitude and the direction of its magnetic field.
prose.source_text: 利用小的通电线圈可以用实验测定磁场中每一点的磁感应强度矢量 $\vec{B}$。例如，可以求得通电导体磁场的大小和方向。

prose.text:
Keep the conductor shape, observation point, and other conditions fixed: in vacuum, or under suitable conditions where a material has a linear magnetic response, the magnitude of the magnetic flux density vector $\vec{B}$ is proportional to the current.
The material around the conductor also affects the field, so current alone does not determine it.

For a simple linear, isotropic, homogeneous medium with negligible boundary effects, use the vacuum field vector $\vec{B}_0$ for the same current and geometry as a reference and compare their magnitudes, writing $\frac{B}{B_0}=\mu$.
This ratio is a dimensionless relative permeability, not the dimensional absolute permeability used in SI.

A material may strengthen or weaken the field;
this simple scalar relation is not a law that applies to every magnetic material.
The magnetic properties of materials are discussed further in the thirteenth chapter.
prose.source_text: 此时，首先发现：磁场与导体中的电流强度成正比。此外，它与充满通电线圈周围空间的介质有非常重要的关系。在有均匀介质时，磁感应强度矢量 $\vec{B}$ 的量值，大于真空中该点矢量 $\vec{B}_0$ 的量值若干倍。表征介质磁性质的比值 $\frac{B}{B_0}=\mu$，叫做**介质的磁导率**。我们在第十三章中将详细讨论各种物质的磁性质。

prose.text:
Several current-carrying loops can contribute to the magnetic flux density vector $\vec{B}$ at the same point.
In vacuum, or in a medium satisfying the conditions for linear superposition, add the magnetic flux density vectors produced by the individual loops at that point to obtain the total field.

This is vector addition, not simply addition of the field magnitudes.
Even if the current stays unchanged, moving or reorienting one loop may change the magnitude and direction of the total magnetic flux density vector $\vec{B}$ at the point.
prose.source_text: 在某处的磁感应强度矢量 $\vec{B}$，可以是由许多单个回路产生的磁感应强度矢量的几何和。改变单个回路的位置时，将引起这个总和的分量的改变，所以将影响这一点的矢量 $\vec{B}$ 的大小和方向。

prose.text:
A loop can be divided into many very short sections of wire, called current elements.
If we know the magnetic field contribution of each element at a point, we can add those contributions as vectors, under the applicable conditions, to find the field of the whole current-carrying loop.

Different contributions may point in different directions, so their magnitudes cannot simply be added.
Finding the individual contributions and completing the calculation requires more detailed laws and mathematical methods;
this lesson does not derive the formula.
prose.source_text: 如果知道各个单个电流元产生的磁感应强度是多少，就可以计算出任意通电回路的磁场。但是，确定单个电流元所产生的磁感应强度矢量的规律，是十分复杂的，因此我们将不讨论它。
